responsibility: Top-level RTL machine description for the ARC port. It defines ARC unspec codes, register constants, core instruction patterns, predicates/constraint inclusions, prologue/epilogue and EH patterns, and includes the family-specific scheduler files plus FPX, FPU, SIMD, and atomic subdescriptions, making it the central recognizer/expander description for ARC instruction selection and assembly emission.
same_name_distinction: This is the machine-description file for ARC instruction selection and attributes; unlike arc.cc and arc.h it expresses RTL patterns, unspec enums, and includes of subdescriptions in .md form, and unlike arc.opt it is not an option-definition file.
